title: angelica nubigena
intro: Angelica nubigena, commonly known as Himalayan angelica, is a plant species in the carrot family, native to the Himalayas. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Angelica nubigena are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including essential oils, flavonoids, and coumarins, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, studies suggest that Angelica nubigena may also possess anti-cancer and anti-diabetic properties, although further research is needed to confirm these findings.
